description: ISA-95 Part 4 cl. 5 (ResourceNetworkConnection): one connection from a resource to a resource of a resource relationship network.

properties.name: resource_network_connection_id
properties.description: Identity of the resource network connection: its own id from the source system (ISA-95 ResourceNetworkConnection.ID).

properties.name: resource_network_connection_type_ref
properties.description: The ResourceNetworkConnectionType (DEFINED_BY; ISA-95 ResourceNetworkConnection → ResourceNetworkConnectionType). Optional.

properties.name: from_resource_ref
properties.description: The key of the object this ResourceNetworkConnection points at (any object, FROM_RESOURCE); its profile in from_resource_profile. Optional.

properties.name: from_resource_profile
properties.description: The profile (profileId or label) of the object in from_resource_ref.

properties.name: resource_relationship_network_ref
properties.description: The ResourceRelationshipNetwork this ResourceNetworkConnection is part of (PART_OF; ISA-95 ResourceRelationshipNetwork MADE_UP_OF ResourceNetworkConnection). Optional.

properties.name: to_resource_ref
properties.description: The key of the object this ResourceNetworkConnection points at (any object, TO_RESOURCE); its profile in to_resource_profile. Optional.

properties.name: to_resource_profile
properties.description: The profile (profileId or label) of the object in to_resource_ref.

isa95.note: ISA-95 Part 4 cl. 5 ResourceNetworkConnection: one connection from a resource to a resource of a resource relationship network. Core 4.0.0 (0.3.5, OPEN-0350, owner 07.10.).
isa95.mappingNote: from_resource_profile names the profile of the object in from_resource_ref (B2MML carries the object itself; P9-b). Self-nesting and containment are PART_OF on the child with a reference to the parent (B2MML nests the child inside the parent).
